coverage: All 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory, with 768 local government areas and six FCT area councils (774 local units in total). OCHA COD-AB version 01, valid 17 April 2019 and reviewed 30 October 2025, from OSGOF, eHealth and UNCS. State outlines are dissolved from the same local-area geometry to keep every shared edge consistent. Inland lake water is excluded and has no shoreline stroke. The partial 714-ward layer is not offered as national coverage. Area cards are calculated from mapped land; population and economic figures are not inferred.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
